title: Book Two · Chapter 43: Two Right Answers
story:
Dad takes the brown box to Mr Sun on Monday morning. Ronan walks to school with Leo. He wants to see his own answers again.

Miss Wu calls each child to her desk. The others do quiet work. There is no list of first and second places on the board.

Ronan waits through four names. Then it is his turn.

Miss Wu puts his answer page beside the kite story.

“These two are correct,” she says.

She points to his second answer, then his third. The blue line belongs to the brother. The brother stops to tie it again.

Ronan nods. He looks at the first question.

“Who waits at the field gate?” Miss Wu asks.

“The brother,” he says quietly.

“Please read the last line.”

Ronan finds it. The sister goes to the field gate. The brother is still beside the fence with his loose blue line.

Miss Wu points to the last line.

“The sister waits,” Ronan says.

“Yes.”

He looks at his own answer. His own words are still there: the boy.

“I put the wrong person.”

“You did. Write the right answer below it.”

He writes the girl on the next line. He does not rub out the old answer.

His pencil stays above the paper.

“Did you finish talking to the others this quickly?” he asks.

“Some need longer. We have time for your page now.”

Miss Wu turns the story toward him again.

“Show me the brother.”

Ronan puts his finger beside the fence.

“And the sister?”

He moves another finger to the gate. His two hands are far apart on the page.

He looks at the first answer again. He remembers the brother's loose line very clearly. He did not follow the sister to the gate.

“The blue line made me think of him,” he says.

“Yes. Now read the part about her.”

He reads it quietly. The sister goes ahead. Ronan leaves his finger beside her until he reaches the end.

At a desk behind them, someone drops a ruler. Ronan looks up, then brings his eyes back to his own page.

Miss Wu checks the new answer. Then she asks him to take the page back to his seat.

At lunch, she puts the book-corner jobs on the board. Mei and another child will keep the cards on Wednesday. Ronan will sort books. Other children have turns later in the week.

Ronan looks at the card job. He wanted that one. He copies his own turn into his notebook.

Jun comes over at the afternoon break.

“How did it go?”

“Fine.”

“All three?”

Ronan holds his book closer to his chest. Two answers are right. The first is wrong. He knows that now.

“No problems,” he says.

Jun nods and asks about the ball. Ronan goes outside with him. The corrected answer stays inside his book.

At home, he puts the page on his bed. He looks at his two answers to the first question. The boy above. The girl below.

Mum is at the table with a coat. She counts the buttons, then writes a name on its label.

Ronan comes to stand beside her.

“I told Jun it was all right.”

“The reading?”

“Yes. Two answers were right. One was wrong.”

Mum puts her pencil down.

“Did you tell him about that one?”

“No. I wanted to look clever.”

“Does he know the truth now?”

“No.”

Ronan touches the coat label, then takes his hand away.

“I need to tell him.”

Mum moves her chair so he can sit beside her.

“You can talk to him tomorrow.”

“Will you come?”

“Do you want me there?”

Ronan shakes his head.

“I said it. I can tell him.”

Mum nods. Then she asks him to hold the coat straight. She needs to check its two sleeves.

Ronan holds one shoulder in each hand. Mum steps back to look. He keeps the cloth clear of her pencil and waits.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

correct＝正确的；sister＝妹妹；gate＝大门；answer＝答案。

## 理解问题

1. 老师指出Ronan哪一道题读反了？
2. Ronan对Jun说了什么，又在家承认了什么？

## 读句子

**Miss Wu / points to / the last line.** 吴老师／指向／最后一行。
